-97.50090,35.47750.name: OU Health Reproductive Medicine
-97.50090,35.47750.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: LaTasha B. Craig, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-121.53023,38.58046.name: Valley Biosystems

-76.80000,39.06000.name: Walter Reed Army Institute Of Research

-76.80000,39.06000.desc: Federal research facility registered with USDA APHIS under the Animal Welfare Act, certificate 10-F-0002. This is the address on the registration. A research registration is issued to an organisation rather than to a building, so for a university it is usually the research administration office and the animals are elsewhere on campus or in another city. Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

-72.50000,-12.50000.name: CFGS - Centro de Fertilidad y GinecologÃ­a del Sur
-72.50000,-12.50000.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: http://tominaga.com.pe/. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

-77.03000,38.88700.name: USDA Risk Management Agency — federal crop insurance
-77.03000,38.88700.desc: Underwrites most US crop insurance, and its rules on which practices and varieties are covered shape what a farmer can afford to plant. Insurance coverage is a stronger determinant of what actually goes in the ground than any approval, and it is set by an agency nobody thinks of as a biotechnology regulator.
